name: pynanosvg
reason: Release 0.3.1 documents a NanoSVG binding, but its source build failed on the recorded Python 3.13 environment because Cython was not declared as a build requirement. No valid-control result was established.

name: puresvg
reason: Release 0.1.1 rendered the valid 2×1 control's red first rectangle but omitted the second green rectangle. This partial result was not accepted as verification of the tested document.

name: pysvg
reason: Release 0.2.2 exposes pysvg.parser but the installed module has Python 2 print syntax and raises SyntaxError on Python 3.13. No valid-control result was established.

name: pysvg-py3
reason: Release 0.2.2.post3 shares the pysvg namespace with pysvg. The combined environment resolved to Python 2 syntax; an isolated installation and valid-control run remain to be done before counting this distribution.

name: svg.path
reason: The documented parse_path API takes an already extracted SVG path-data fragment, not a local SVG document. This batch did not establish a document-level input API.

name: svgpath2mpl
reason: The documented parse_path API takes an already extracted path-data fragment and converts it to a Matplotlib Path. This is not an SVG document parser path by itself.
